title_as_printed: Our measured Bunsen coefficients (beta x 10^3) for hydrogen in distilled water and seawater.
pressure_note: total gas-phase pressure nominally 1 atm (hydrogen saturated with water vapour); Bunsen coefficient refers to hydrogen partial pressure of 1 atm; corrected for volume change on dissolution using a partial molal volume of H2 of 26 cm3/mol

composition.other_species: natural seawater (Oregon coast, filtered, acidified to pH<3.2 with 4N HCl, salinity adjusted by dilution or evaporation); column 'Salinity' in per mil, measured after the experiment with an inductive salinometer and corrected for the HCl addition; salinity 0.000 = twice-distilled water (gas-in-pure-water rows)

conversion_needs: Bunsen definition: cm3 of H2 at STP absorbed per cm3 of solution at the measurement temperature at 1 atm H2 partial pressure; conversion to mole fraction/molality needs the solution density and STP molar volume
salinity (per mil, seawater) to NaCl-equivalent molality needs a seawater composition assumption; pressure unit atm (101.325 kPa)
notes: Printed in isotherm groups separated by rules (no label rows). Row at -0.35 C is below 273.15 K and the seawater rows are outside the six-ion set; all kept. Replicate-like rows (10.00/10.02 C at salinity 0.000; 10.02/10.04 C at salinity 19.694/19.736) are kept.
mapping_fix: 2026-10-02: volume_basis solution (Weiss 1977 defines the Bunsen coefficient per cm3 of solution; Murray and Riley compute the sample volume from the seawater density, Knudsen tables) ; salinity column added to composition.per_row
